description: Institutional transport-fuel sheet 2026: petrol and fleet diesel monthly litres for May - Jul 2026, transcribed from the sheet supplied and approved for import by the project owner on 2026-10-01. Litres are the only source activity. The sheet's emission factor and emission columns are informational and were not transcribed: emissions are calculated by the backend with the governed PETROL and DIESEL factors. Jan - Apr 2026 are already held from transport_staging and are not part of this source; August 2026 has not been approved for import.
